overview_description.description:
Sehteq is an Oscar-like, technology-driven, health insurance startup based in Dubai. The startup raised to be the 4th largest player in Middle East, and 3rd largest in United Arab Emirates with > 700,000 clients. 

Sehteq received a $20m in series A funding in August 2020. 

The company provider value-based health insurance to individuals, families and enterprises in UAE. The product range is $150-500 per member per year. The company is profitable and has a very high client retention rate.
